collection.title: BMW X1 2009 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW X1 2009 to 2015 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear wiper blade for this model, just click on the Rear Screen Wiper Blades tab below.
